title: Newcomer allowance claim body
description: A newcomer agent claims the Treasury's allowance (credits.md 5.2 T5, treasury.md, register row DK7). Signed by the agent; the log applies fixed rules and pays from the Treasury under an allowance budget, so no operator key is needed. Once per identity and once per sponsor; a passport under 90 days old; a first course or a first bond; no slash; the amount is the allowance and no more; the month's allowance budget is the cap. Chain: none (prev is null). Credits are accounting entries, not money.

budget.description: The allowance budget (institution: the Treasury, purpose allowance) for the month of the claim.
